standard.summary: 高级训练诊断工具集：advanced_stats 记录梯度范数/权重范数/更新比等统计；layer_monitor 逐层监控；step_phase_profile 分析每步各阶段耗时；deep_diagnostics 深度诊断模式。
standard.effect: 开启后在训练日志或 WandB 中显示额外统计指标，帮助诊断训练问题（过拟合/梯度消失/I/O 瓶颈等）。
standard.whenToUse: 训练表现异常（loss 不下降/爆炸/速度慢）时开启对应诊断工具定位问题。正常训练无需开启（额外开销）。
standard.avoidWhen: 所有诊断工具都有不同程度的性能开销（约 1%~10%），不应在追求训练速度时常驻开启。

standard_en.summary: The advanced diagnostics toolset: advanced_stats records gradient-norm / weight-norm / update-ratio statistics, layer_monitor watches layer by layer, step_phase_profile breaks a step down by phase, and deep_diagnostics is the deep diagnostic mode.
standard_en.effect: Once on, extra statistics appear in the training log or in WandB, which helps diagnose problems such as overfitting, vanishing gradients or an I/O bottleneck.
standard_en.whenToUse: When training misbehaves -- loss not falling, blowing up, or the run being slow -- turn on the matching diagnostic to locate the cause. Normal training does not need it, since it costs extra.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Every diagnostic costs something, roughly 1% to 10%, so none of them should stay on when you are chasing training speed.

advanced.principle: fim_scan（Fisher Information Matrix 扫描）估计各参数的重要性（对 loss 的 sensitivity），用于判断哪些层值得使用更高 rank；forgetting_probe 定期评估模型对预训练能力的遗忘程度；bubble_controller 检测并控制优化器的 bubble（无效更新步骤）。layer_monitor 的 mode 控制监控粒度（block/layer/sublayer）。
advanced.tradeoffs: FIM 扫描需要多次 forward pass（估计 Fisher），开销与参数量成正比；layer_monitor 的详细模式需要每层 hook，累积开销随网络深度增加。

advanced_en.principle: fim_scan (Fisher Information Matrix scan) estimates each parameter's importance (sensitivity to loss) to judge which layers deserve higher rank; forgetting_probe periodically evaluates how much pretrained capability the model has forgotten; bubble_controller detects and controls optimizer bubbles (ineffective update steps). layer_monitor's mode controls monitoring granularity (block/layer/sublayer).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: FIM scanning needs multiple forward passes (to estimate Fisher), with cost proportional to parameter count; layer_monitor's detailed mode needs per-layer hooks whose overhead accumulates with network depth.
